facts.fact: IANOR's draft national standardisation programme for 2026 lists, under revisions, the national standard NA ISO/IEC 14651 (NA 13037), on information technology string comparison and collation, to be brought up to ISO/IEC 14651:2025; the programme's publication date, February 2026, is its only date.

note: Carried from the qualitystandards study's reading of this document, matched to this study's questions from the fact's own text.
